app_context: B2B SaaS CRM Dashboard for Tour & Travel + Umrah
theme: Light mode by default (crisp data visibility) with Dark mode support.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant for SaaS/CRM - highly legible but with character.

colors.description: Crisp white/gray data surfaces framed by deep midnight blue structural elements. Warm sand/gold accents for the Umrah travel connection.
rules: NO Teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboard.
NEVER use pure #000000 or #808080. Tint grays with blue (slate).
Active sidebar items must use white text with bg-white/10 on the dark sidebar.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid background (`bg-white`), crisp 1px border (`border-slate-200`), slight ambient shadow (`shadow-sm`). Max border-radius: 8px (`rounded-md`).
surfaces.headers: Solid background (`bg-white`) or heavy Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90`). CRITICAL: NO full transparent background on headers or dropdowns over scrolling content.
surfaces.modals_dropdowns: Solid background (`bg-white`), heavy shadow (`shadow-xl`), 1px border. MUST not be transparent.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use Grid Borders style for data-heavy sections (e.g., `border-collapse`, `border-b border-r border-slate-200`).

component_name.buttons: Shadcn Button (customized with rounded-md and amber primary color)
component_name.inputs: Shadcn Input, Select, Checkbox (with focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-amber-500)
component_name.tables: Shadcn Table (dense variant for CRM, alternating row colors)

grids.dashboard_bento: High Density Grid. Base: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4`. Tight gaps: `gap-4` or `gap-6`.

layouts.auth_page: Split-screen layout (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2`). Left side: immersive image of Mecca/Umrah. Right side: Login form, centered vertically.
layouts.dashboard: Persistent left sidebar (`w-64`, fixed), top header (`h-16`, sticky, solid/glass bg), main content area with generous padding (`p-6 md:p-8`).
layouts.responsiveness: Sidebar collapses to a hamburger menu on mobile (opens in a Shadcn Sheet). Main content goes to 1 column.

motion.transitions: Specific transitions only. E.g., `transition-colors duration-200`, `transition-transform duration-200`. NEVER use `transition-all`.
motion.hover_states: Buttons and list items must have distinct, fast hover states (`hover:bg-slate-100`). Rows in tables should subtly highlight on hover.
motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders for dashboard widgets instead of generic spinners.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio (APCA). Amber buttons must have white text. Gray text must be at least `text-slate-600`.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-amber-500 focus-visible:outline-none`).
accessibility.data_testid: CRITICAL: All buttons, links, form inputs, and key UI elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='sidebar-crm-link'`).

image_urls.description: High-quality image of Mecca architecture for the split-screen login and forgot password pages to establish context.

3d_libraries_and_steps.reasoning: This is a heavy B2B CRM dashboard focused on data density, rapid interactions, and analytics. 3D libraries would impede performance and offer no functional value. Use pure 2D charting (echarts/recharts) instead.

instructions_to_main_agent: Phase 1 execution ONLY: Focus on Authentication (login, reset, forgot), User Management (CRUD), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Role-specific sidebar, Audit Log, Company Settings, Global Settings, 403 Forbidden.
Ensure all components are `.jsx` or `.js`, NOT `.tsx`.
Implement the role-based sidebar so it reads the user's role from state/context and maps the allowed modules correctly. Super Admin = all, Sales = limited, Accounting = limited.
Set up dummy data for users, audit logs, and settings to make the UI look 'production-ready'.
Strictly follow the color palette (no teal). Apply Amber/Gold as the primary interactive accent.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or `<input type='date'>`. Use Shadcn Select, Dialog, Calendar, Form, and Table components.
Data ownership for Sales (own/branch/all) and HPP access restriction should be represented in the UI (e.g., disabled toggles or hidden columns) based on mock role.
Add a global 403 Forbidden page and set up mock routing so unauthorized access to an admin route by 'Sales' redirects there.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the generic 'AI slop' aesthetic. DO NOT center align the entire app container.
Create depth through subtle borders and layered shadow hierarchy (z-index).
Use glass-morphism (blur 12-24px) for sticky headers, but strictly with a semi-opaque background color to avoid unreadable text.
Do NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Only animate specific properties.
Always use modern button styles (e.g., sharp or slightly rounded with interaction animations).
NEVER use Emoji characters as UI icons. Use lucide-react instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Use 2-3x more spacing for layouts. Cramped designs look cheap.
Include `data-testid` attributes on every interactive element for QA.
